_comment: Config/DefaultEngine.ini lines of the validated Zaliniy state (2026-09-30). offline/update_ini.py sets each key in its section (replaces an existing key=value line anywhere in that section, otherwise appends it) after a dated backup. Editor must be CLOSED; restart afterwards.

base.why: 1024 MB pool filled up and Nanite silently lowered tree quality. NEVER 2048 - it asserts (pool must stay below the max GPU allocation)
ROOT CAUSE of distant trees degrading over time: the streamer scaled quality down to 0.3 when the pool was >85 % full; 1.0 forbids the downscale
was 75: sub-pixel leaves were shaded at 75 % and fell apart at distance
less TSR sparkle/ghosting on thin leaves and branches
depth inside shaded canopies (lower values made crowns flat)

high_tier.why: HW ray tracing on (only GPUs with >= 12 GB VRAM, e.g. RTX 3090/4070 Ti+). Default project keeps 0 + EnableOnDemand=1
HWRT Lumen: closest to path tracing GI. Note: canopies darken slowly (tens of seconds) while Lumen converges - judge only after settling

runtime_profile_note: The project applies tiers at runtime with Scripts/profile_lumen.py (console: py "<Project>/Scripts/profile_lumen.py"); on Zaliniy it contains r.RayTracing.Enable 1, r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing 1 and r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.FoliageOcclusionStrength 1.0 (backup profile_lumen.py.bak_20260930).
